# Hi, I'm Merwin Jasper Moreno 👋

**WordPress Developer & Project Manager** based in the Philippines.

I have 3+ years of experience building high-performing websites, managing servers, and setting up automation systems that generate leads. I got into tech in junior high and started working professionally while I was still in college.

## What I do

- **Website development:** WordPress and Webflow sites, including rebuilds (e.g. Wix → WordPress)
- **Maintenance, hosting and domains:** keeping client sites fast, secure and online
- **Automation and lead generation:** Go High Level chatbots, workflows and email campaigns
- **Project management:** client communication, task delegation and quality checks
